author: blekek.k
title: Looking for illustrators for trading card project
content: Hi warga threads! We're looking for illustrators for our little trading card project. Whether you draw professionally, as a hobby, are still a student, or already work full-time, feel free to reach out. We're looking for artists that draws: Anime / manga style illustrations; Cartoon / semi-cartoon illustration; Pokemon / One Piece / MTG TCG artwork; Semi-realistic illustrations; and any other art styles. Comment if you're interested or DM me directly! Follow-up (09/21/26): Thanks you guys for reaching out. I'll be checking your portfolio. For the ones who haven't sent in their portfolio, you can provide a link where I can see your previous works.

author: Veli Raiya
title: Looking for fantasy map designer and character illustrator
content: Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! Definitely doesn't have to be the same artist for both. Bonus points if you're a fantasy author recommending someone you've personally worked with. See the next posts for more details. For character art, I tend to gravitate toward more realistic, epic fantasy concept art, as opposed to a cartoon illustration. My book is on the lighter side of fantasy, but I love art that still feels grounded and lifelike. I'm definitely open to seeing different styles though, so please share your work/recs! Bonus points if you can do POC and a wide variety of ethnicities! For the map, I'd love something detailed and immersive with that classic fantasy-map feel, but I'm pretty open stylistically. Contact: reply on the thread with work/recs or DM.
